plugins.name: gh-gemini-review-loop
plugins.description: Opinionated Gemini Code Assist PR loop for solo builders and small teams using Claude Code. Reads real review-thread state, supports severity filtering, stops at a hard 3-cycle cap, auto-resolves stale and addressed-by-reply threads, and can post a live sticky-receipt comment for background visibility.
